name: Fluxo PVP [MATCHMAKING]
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Fluxo 

A fast-paced PvP experience inspired by FiveM, built around one rule:


🎯 1 Headshot = 1 Kill 

Fight other players across multiple maps, improve your aim, and prove you're the best.

🔫 Game modes:
• Duels 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4
• FFA: Free for All 
• AIMLAB Training
• Shooter game


🆕 Latest Update: 
• Fixed Lag
• Added Round-Based Matches
• Added Map Voting
• Performance Improvements & Bug Fixes
• Added Map Paleto Bank


🚫 Zero tolerance for exploiters. Cheaters will be reported and be banned. 

🔒 Private Servers: 
• 100x Vote Power for owner
• Custom Round Settings

🏆 Competitive PvP 
🗺️ Multiple Maps
📱 PC, Mobile & Console Support 

Join the fight and make your name known.
